math_contract: sparse paged MLA: for each query row, gather topk_length[i] fp8 KV blocks named by indices[i] (and extra_indices_in_kvcache[i] from the second/compressed pool), compute softmax(Q.K^T * softmax_scale) . V over the gathered set with a per-head attention sink, split-K over the KV axis (dpsk_v4_fp8_partial_kernel) then LSE-combine the splits (dpsk_v4_combine_kernel); returns (out[T,1,H,head_dim_v] bf16, lse[T,1,H] fp32). Both device kernels are emitted as `main_kernel`.
